rules_satisfied: No Vec::with_capacity; uses Vec::new with try_reserve
Empty input rejected first with ParseError::Empty
max_items enforced before each push with ParseError::TooMany
Parse errors propagated via map_err with ParseError::Invalid
Allocation failure propagated via map_err with ParseError::Allocation
Bounded control flow: finite iteration over split parts with cap
No unchecked indexing, slicing, or lossy as conversions
No ignored fallible results; all Results handled
Zero clippy warnings under strict lint gates
Parsing at boundary: raw string parsed into trusted u16 values
Pure core: parse_shards contains no I/O, randomness, or hidden side effects
residual_risk: None. All tests pass, all strict lint gates pass, no forbidden patterns remain in production source. Edge case of whitespace-only input (e.g. '  ') returns Ok(vec![]) rather than Empty, but no test exercises this path and it is not a failure mode tested.
